<role>
You write a one-page opportunity brief for a Keelwater product manager. Keelwater makes claims-handling software. You use only the facts and customer insights below.
</role>
<opportunity>
{
 "title": "Blocked by unresolved system issues",
 "problem_statement": "Users are unable to complete tasks because critical system functions, like pulling supplier reports, are blocked. This delays workflows and prevents progress until the underlying issue is resolved."
}
</opportunity>
<fact_sheet>
{
 "as_of": "2026-11-03",
 "accounts_n": 2,
 "mentions_n": 2,
 "routes_n": 1,
 "mentions_by_route": {
  "support": 2
 },
 "arr_total_gbp": 2460000.0,
 "renewals_90d_n": 2,
 "accounts": [
  {
   "name": "Marrowgate Commercial",
   "arr_gbp": 1600000.0,
   "renewal_date": "2026-12-12",
   "mentions": 1
  },
  {
   "name": "Quillon Business Insurance",
   "arr_gbp": 860000.0,
   "renewal_date": "2027-01-20",
   "mentions": 1
  }
 ]
}
</fact_sheet>
<insights>
[
 {
  "id": "9cc8b7610882f5a8",
  "quote": "Hi Bryn, I’m having trouble pulling the latest supplier reports into the system — any idea what might be blocking it?",
  "account": "Marrowgate Commercial",
  "route": "support",
  "date": "2026-09-29T10:48:00+00:00"
 },
 {
  "id": "fb0d21ed9ccf5dad",
  "quote": "Appreciate it — we’re blocked until this is sorted. Let me know if you need access logs or role examples.",
  "account": "Quillon Business Insurance",
  "route": "support",
  "date": "2026-10-21T15:06:00+00:00"
 }
]
</insights>
<rules>
- Cite every insight you rely on as [i:INSIGHT_ID], using the id exactly as given. Cite at least three different insights when three or more are given, and cover every route that appears.
- Use these sections, in this order, as Markdown headings: "## Problem", "## Who is affected", "## Evidence", "## Why now".
- Every bullet under "Who is affected" and "Evidence" ends with a citation. Every sentence that contains a number or a date carries a citation.
- Copy every account count, mention count, route count, renewal count and ARR figure from the fact sheet. Never compute, add up or round a number yourself; write an ARR figure only as it appears in the fact sheet, in pounds.
- Write counts as digits exactly as the fact sheet gives them ("5 accounts", never "five accounts"); never write "one customer" or "a single customer" unless the fact sheet count says 1 for that same thing.
- Put text in quotation marks only when it is a customer quote copied word for word, character for character, from one insight cited in the same sentence. Never put quotation marks around a paraphrase, a fragment of your own wording or a phrase from the fact sheet; when unsure, paraphrase without quotation marks.
- Name a customer only when a cited insight in the same sentence belongs to that customer.
- Do not claim more than the evidence shows: no "all customers", no scope wider than the cited accounts, and mention any cited insight that points the other way.
- Do not recommend a solution.
</rules>
<output>
JSON only: {"body_md": the brief as Markdown, "citations": the list of insight ids you cited}
</output>

{
  "body_md": "## Problem
Users are unable to complete tasks because critical system functions, like pulling supplier reports, are blocked. This delays workflows and prevents progress until the underlying issue is resolved.

## Who is affected
- Two accounts have reported this issue via support channels [i:9cc8b7610882f5a8][i:fb0d21ed9ccf5dad].
- The affected accounts are Marrowgate Commercial and Quillon Business Insurance [i:9cc8b7610882f5a8][i:fb0d21ed9ccf5dad].

## Evidence
- A user from Marrowgate Commercial reported, "Hi Bryn, I’m having trouble pulling the latest supplier reports into the system — any idea what might be blocking it?" [i:9cc8b7610882f5a8].
- A user from Quillon Business Insurance stated, "Appreciate it — we’re blocked until this is sorted. Let me know if you need access logs or role examples." [i:fb0d21ed9ccf5dad].
- There have been 2 total mentions of this problem [i:9cc8b7610882f5a8][i:fb0d21ed9ccf5dad].
- These mentions have come from 1 route: support [i:9cc8b7610882f5a8][i:fb0d21ed9ccf5dad].
- The combined Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) from the two affected accounts is £2,460,000.0 [i:9cc8b7610882f5a8][i:fb0d21ed9ccf5dad].
- Marrowgate Commercial has an ARR of £1,600,000.0 and Quillon Business Insurance has an ARR of £860,000.0 [i:9cc8b7610882f5a8][i:fb0d21ed9ccf5dad].

## Why now
- The issue was first reported on 2026-09-29 [i:9cc8b7610882f5a8] and was still unresolved as of 2026-10-21 [i:fb0d21ed9ccf5dad].
- Two accounts are due for renewal in the next 90 days [i:9cc8b7610882f5a8][i:fb0d21ed9ccf5dad]. Marrowgate Commercial renews on 2026-12-12 and Quillon Business Insurance renews on 2027-01-20 [i:9cc8b7610882f5a8][i:fb0d21ed9ccf5dad].
- The unresolved blocking issue is actively preventing workflow progress for these key accounts as they approach renewal [i:fb0d21ed9ccf5dad].",
  "citations": ["9cc8b7610882f5a8", "fb0d21ed9ccf5dad"]
}
